description: Get the most recently introduced bills across all congressional sponsors. Each bill includes the sponsor block (bioguideId, fullName, party, state, politicianSlug) so persona agents can link directly to the sponsor detail page. politicianSlug is null when the sponsor is no longer in the active roster (typically ex-members). Requires CONGRESS_API_KEY on the backend.

congress.description: Congress number to filter (default: 119 for current session)

name: get_recently_sponsored_bills
title: Get Recently Sponsored Bills (Cross-Politician)
